quest.title: 1,001 Cups of Coffee
quest.description: Maddah, who is at the Puspa Café, is currently fretting over not having any new tales to tell...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There was that time in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Huh? Mondstadt, the beloved land of the Anemo Archon...? According to the caravan, a gale-summoning dragon emerged there. That should make for a good story, I'm sure.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: But you get nothing more than broken legends from the caravans, which can often sound rather fake.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Something like... "A winged Traveler came from the skies, pursuing the dragon tens of thousands of meters in the air!" or something like that.

choices.text: Actually, there was an aerial chase...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: #Hmm, and something like... "{M#He}{F#She} infiltrated the Cathedral alone, stealing a powerful weapon bestowed with the Anemo Archon's might!"

choices.text: I did actually sneak into the Cathedral...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: #Really? What about this, then? "In the end, {M#he}{F#she} spotted the dragon's weakness and attacked its old scar. Bathed in dragon blood, {M#he}{F#she} became immortal!"

choices.text: I did target a specific spot...
I was just purifying the toxin that had a hold over the dragon's mind...
The Holy Lyre der Himmel isn't a weapon.
The aerial chase occurred thanks to a wind glider...

talks.objective: Go to the café and talk to Maddah

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Ugh, is everyone leaving already? I hadn't even started my story yet...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: My word. At this rate, I won't even be able to afford my coffee...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Um, are you... the Traveler? *sigh* As you can see, I exchange stories for coffee expenses here in this coffee shop.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: But I'm drawing smaller and smaller audiences recently... At this rate, I doubt that I'll be able to afford even coffee foam.

choices.text: So you're like a bard from Mondstadt...?

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Well... I haven't met one, but I suppose we might be quite similar, yes.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: You know, the ancient heroic legends are intriguing, but no tale stays attractive if you tell it day after day... I have to find some new material.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: *sigh* Stories from outside Sumeru are the best. They are new and interesting, and...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: I'm at liberty to make adaptations. No one would notice, since no one actually knows what really happened... *cough*!

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: However, I must first understand the stories that I mean to tell.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: I have collected tales from all over the world, such as the story of Dvalin, the Rite of Parting, and so on...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: But I got these stories from others, and I'm sure they must have already come to me embellished. I don't quite trust those stories.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Traveler, I have heard from the Adventurers' Guild that you have been traveling the world. Is that true?

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Could you please tell me about your experiences around the world, then?

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: That would allow me to get my stories straight and make them sound somewhat more believable...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Of course, we'll split my earnings from the stories I tell!

choices.text: I can help you...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Thank you! So, where do we start?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can hear stories from everywhere. You know that, right?

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Well, I have collected tales from all over the world, such as the story of Dvalin, the Rite of Parting, and so on...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: But these stories have been told over and over before they reached my ears, so I'm sure they must have already come embellished. I don't quite trust those stories.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Stories from a traveler like you are well-needed in such cases. With your help, I could fix my stories and make them sound more believable...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How embellished is embellished?

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Well, ah, I mean that they sounded like total nonsense even to the casual ear...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Hahaha... a knight with wings on their back, and a swordsman defeating a god alone, just to name a few in brief first...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Alright, let's get to it. What story would you like to share?

choices.text: How embellished is embellished?
So you're like a storyteller from Liyue...?

talks.objective: Go to the café and talk to Maddah

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: *sigh* You're here, Traveler. What do you think of the story I told today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was pretty crazy...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Well... That's about the same as what the other listeners said. I might have focused too much on drama, neglecting "truthfulness" in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: *sigh* More changes are needed for these stories to work, I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Thanks for the stories, by the way. Please, take this as payment.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Don't forget to share new stories with me when you come across them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There was that time in Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Huh? Liyue... According to the caravans, the various factions struggled and schemed against each other when their Archon fell. That should make for a great story.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: But you get nothing more than broken legends from the caravans, which can often sound rather fake.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Something like... "the Traveler who organized the Rite of Parting became a figure much-sought-after by all sides."

choices.text: I did take part in the Rite of Parting...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: #Well, or something like... "{M#He}{F#She} confronted the Overlord of the Vortex above the seas, sweeping even the Jade Chamber into the waves with the power of {M#his}{F#her} blade!"

choices.text: I did face the Overlord...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: #Really? What about this one, then? "In the end, {M#he}{F#she} settled the conflicts all alone, establishing a new era in Liyue Harbor."

choices.text: The conflicts were indeed settled...
It was a joint effort by everyone from Liyue.
The Jade Chamber was the key to defeating the Overlord.
I was actually running errands with someone...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So we did have this adventure in Inazuma...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Huh? Inazuma, the blessed land of the Electro Archon...? The caravans bring word that some defied the Archon's Vision Hunt Decree. That should make for an excellent tale.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: But the caravans only bring scattered tales that never quite sound reliable...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: #You know, things like "An Outlander initiated a duel against a Fatui Harbinger, turning {M#his}{F#her} opponent to ash with one strike!"

choices.text: I did win the duel...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: #Well, or something like, "{M#He}{F#She} stood against the formidable Shogun, escaping her Musou no Hitotachi without a single scratch!"

choices.text: I did escape...

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: #Really? What about this one? "In the end, {M#he}{F#she} was empowered by the Statue of the Omnipresent God, and even changed the will of an Archon..."

choices.text: I did change the Shogun's mind...
The real key was everyone's "wishes."
Someone else blocked the strike.
The Shogun was the one levying the punishment.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: I see... Though the drama has been cut down a fair bit, these stories do indeed sound more "truthful."

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: It really felt like I was talking to a true witness! Well, these legends make far more sense now, indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. Now that I've figured all this out, please, do stop by to hear my stories tomorrow night!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: I see... So the legends are basically true? Wow, fact really is stranger than fiction sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: But I suppose these tales wouldn't have spread had they not been utterly amazing, eh? Guess I can bring them up a notch, to boot...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. I think I've figured all this out, so please, do stop by to hear my stories tomorrow night!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Hmm... This could use a few touches here as well...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Ahem, today's tale took place in a faraway land. Please enjoy "The Song of Anemo and the Dragon"!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...Back when the dragon came, none knew its name. Who could save Mondstadt from peril? Who would keep its creatures safe?

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...The destined warrior spread their wings, the Holy Lyre der Himmel in hand, yes, the very tool of the Anemo Archon. Its strings brought forth the thousand winds, showing forth its mountain-moving might!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...The warrior roared, their blade blazing like a falling star! The dragon lay defeated in the ruins, its slayer stronger than ever!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: The story... It's pretty new, and yet, the events don't flow logically at all.

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: The protagonist just started the fight without a word and defeated the dragon way too quickly... It just seems somewhat weird...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Um... Well... Today's story ends here! Please do come again! Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: So! The story today took place in a faraway country. Please enjoy "The Tale of the Golden-Haired Hero"!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...When the Exuvia fell from the sky, ancient Stone Harbor was in chaos. But thanks to this traveler's feat, the land saw peace once again.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...However, a monster emerged from the waters, and fierce battle was joined. Even the sky changed color, and the very land was thrown out of order. Even the Jade Chamber was blown to smithereens!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...The waves settled, but conflicts remained. The Traveler stood forth to quell the disagreements between mortal and adeptus. Their sage words turned the tide, ushering Liyue onto a new path!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: The story... It's pretty new, and yet, the events don't flow logically at all.

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: That's right! How did the protagonist persuade both sides even though the protagonist hasn't said much before then...?

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Um... Well... Today's story ends here! Please do come again! Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Well then, the story for today took place in a faraway country. Please enjoy "An Outland Blade in Inazuma"!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: #...The thunder can be heard beyond distant seas — the destined Traveler is about to arrive. {M#He}{F#She} roamed the islands like lightning, {M#his}{F#her} great deeds sung of by all.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...Though aforetime she did as she pleased, the wicked witch could not escape defeat. Even the sea-severing strike could not halt the Traveler's steps!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...And the Statue of the Omnipresent God, powered by the wishes of thousands of hearts, shattered the skies with a mighty roar, casting all enemies to the wayside!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: The story... It's pretty new, and yet, the events don't flow logically at all.

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: That whole bit with the giant statue just comes out of nowhere, almost as if we were running out of believable story bits or something...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Um... Well... Today's story ends here! Please do come again! Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Ahem, today's tale took place in a faraway land. Please enjoy "The Song of Anemo and the Dragon"!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...Back when the dragon came, none knew its name. Who could save Mondstadt from peril? Who would keep its creatures safe?

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...The hero came forth on the wind, as the bard played his lyre and sang softly: "Why has a thousand-year vigil been ended in a single day? The toxic blood of the Abyss has clouded the dragon's perception."

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...The demonic wind cleared, and the toxic blood was cleansed. Please, all you who come after, carve that name into your memory. For who is this song dedicated to? The Dragon of the East, Dvalin!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Hey! There we go! Now that's an interesting story!

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: The antagonist turned out to be forced into that position... That's always a moving development.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Today's story ends here. Please do come again!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: So! The story today took place in a faraway country. Please enjoy "The Tale of the Golden-Haired Hero"!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...When the Exuvia plummeted from the skies, the ancient stone harbor was plunged into chaos, and the Sea of Clouds churned in the shadows. So did the Traveler arrive, and so was pulled into the vortex.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...Despite the many conflicts along the way, all was put aside to defend a shared home. Osial of the Vortex emerged from the seas, and moonlight shone upon the Jade Chamber in the skies. Its delicate construction sank 'midst the flow, but at great expense, they delivered the final blow!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...Liyue has been open to all peoples throughout the Geo Archon's reign — to embrace an era without their archon is no impossible thing! Nestlings must now fly on their own — the ancient Stone Harbor shines anew!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Hey! There we go! Now that's an interesting story!

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: Opposing sides establishing trust in cooperation... Now that's what I call, reliable plot development!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Today's story ends here. Please do come again!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Well then, the story for today took place in a faraway country. Please enjoy "An Outland Blade in Inazuma"!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: #...The thunder can be heard beyond distant seas — the destined Traveler is about to arrive. {M#He}{F#She} roamed the islands like lightning, {M#his}{F#her} great deeds sung of by all.

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...The Harbinger fell before the throne — her arrogance her undoing. The Traveler's friends came to the rescue, blocking the thunderous strike of a god unmoving!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: ...Countless stars whirled over the empty realm — each one the wish of a mortal's heart. Thus did those who lived in the land move the divine will of a god!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Hey! There we go! Now that's an interesting story!

dialogues.speaker: Izem
dialogues.text: Hmm... Facing difficulties together with one's friends. That's what heroic tales should be about!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Today's story ends here. Please do come again!

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Ah, so you came, Traveler! What do you think of the story today?

choices.text: It was an interesting tale.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Haha, so you concur with the other listeners, then? In a new era, we shall have new heroes and tales.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Thanks to them, people like me always have a living to earn... Oh, and thanks to you, I can finally afford a nice coffee.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Thanks for the stories you shared with me. Please, take this as your payment.

response.speaker: Maddah
response.text: Don't forget to share new stories with me when you come across them!

choices.text: It was a story well told.
